facts.clause: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself.
Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself.
If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.
She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.
Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.
Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to […] seconds.
Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.
